newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's Lighthouse Hotel to launch IPO.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's Lighthouse Hotel to launch IPO.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Lighthouse Hotel said in a statement on Tuesday it was planning an initial public offer (IPO) of 22.5 million shares at 10 rupees a share.
The statement said the company had already raised 235 million rupees through a private share placement.
Lighthouse is a 60-room hotel in Galle, 115 km (72 miles) south of Colombo, where 50 rooms are already operational. The balance are due to come on stream later this month.
The company is an associate of Colombo blue chip Hayleys Ltd. The issue opens on June 12.
